title: Towards Adaptive Federated Graph Clustering: A Global Community-aware Contrastive Learning-based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.26063v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated graph learning (FGL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train graph models without sharing their private graph data, providing a promising paradigm for mining knowledge from distributed graph repositories. While most existing FGL methods focus on supervised tasks, real-world graphs are often massive and unlabeled, making federated graph clustering an important yet still immature research direction. Notably, this task is particularly challenging due to the inherent subgraph heterogeneity across clients, which leads to client-specific community structures. In this work, we identify two critical limitations in existing federated graph clustering methods: (1) unrealistic pre-defined cluster cardinality assumptions and (2) incomplete inter-community separation. To address these challenges, we propose AdaFGC, an Adaptive Federated graph clustering framework based on Global community-aware Contrastive learning. AdaFGC introdu

translated_title: 迈向自适应联邦图聚类：一种基于全局社区感知对比学习的方法
translated_abstract: 联邦图学习使多个客户端能够在不共享各自私有图数据的情况下协同训练图模型，为从分布式图数据存储中挖掘知识提供了一种有前景的范式。虽然现有的大多数联邦图学习方法都聚焦于监督任务，但现实世界中的图通常是大规模且无标签的，这使得联邦图聚类成为一个重要但尚不成熟的研究方向。值得注意的是，由于客户端之间固有的子图异构性会导致客户端特定的社区结构，这一任务尤其具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们识别出现有联邦图聚类方法的两个关键局限：（1）不切实际的预定义聚类数量假设，（2）不完整的社区间分离。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了AdaFGC，一种基于全局社区感知对比学习的自适应联邦图聚类框架。AdaFGC引入……
tldr: 提出了一种基于全局社区感知对比学习的自适应联邦图聚类框架AdaFGC，解决了现有方法中不切实际的预定义聚类数量假设和不完整的社区间分离问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AdaFGC, an adaptive federated graph clustering framework based on global community-aware contrastive learning, addressing the unrealistic pre-defined cluster cardinality assumptions and incomplete inter-community separation of existing methods.
